verses.text: When Israel walked out of Egypt, when Jacob’s family left a people whose language they didn’t speak,
Judah became God’s holy place, and Israel became the land he ruled.
The sea saw it and ran. The Jordan turned back.
Mountains jumped like rams, and hills like lambs.
Sea, what made you run? Jordan, what made you turn back?
Mountains, why did you jump like rams? Hills, why did you leap like lambs?
Earth, tremble before the Lord, before the God of Jacob,
who turned rock into a pool of water and hard flint into a flowing spring.
